Complete  this in deploy i need proof evidence live verified too FINAL IVX IA INTENT ROUTER REPAIR
RESTORE SENIOR-DEVELOPER CONVERSATION AND EXECUTION END TO END

OWNER DIRECTIVE

The current audit proves that IVX IA has technical knowledge and working infrastructure, but the intent router is broken.

Do not create more agent labels.
Do not create another dashboard.
Do not return another static capability report.
Fix the existing IVX Owner AI message-routing system end to end.

Current confirmed defect:

- Technical questions are incorrectly routed to the developer executor.
- Explanation questions trigger empty deploy tasks.
- “No tools” mode acknowledges the instruction but does not return an LLM answer.
- Public code-review questions are incorrectly blocked by owner authentication.
- Owner AI cannot sustain a technical conversation.
- 8 of 10 tested questions were misrouted, blocked, or answered with canned output.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — DEFINE THE AUTHORITATIVE INTENT TAXONOMY
==================================================

Implement one authoritative intent classification contract.

Required intents:

1. explanation
2. diagnostic
3. architecture
4. code_review
5. code_change
6. deployment
7. task_status
8. data_query
9. business_analysis
10. conversation
11. manual_answer
12. clarification_required

Every message must return:

- intent
- confidence
- actionRequired
- toolsAllowed
- ownerAuthRequired
- destructiveAction
- selectedRoute
- reason
- traceId

Do not allow multiple routers to return conflicting decisions.

ITEM 1:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 2 — ROUTE KNOWLEDGE QUESTIONS TO THE LLM
==================================================

Questions beginning with or semantically equivalent to:

- explain
- what is
- why
- review this
- analyze this
- design this
- compare
- what are the trade-offs
- how does this work
- is this correct
- give me a map
- give me an opinion
- summarize
- diagnose conceptually

must route to:

LLM_TEXT_RESPONSE

They must not:

- create a task
- commit code
- trigger CI
- trigger Render
- enter COMMITTING
- enter DEPLOYING
- require owner deploy approval

Return a full answer directly in chat.

ITEM 2:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 3 — ROUTE EXECUTION COMMANDS TO THE DEVELOPER WORKER
==================================================

Only explicit action requests should route to the developer executor.

Examples:

- fix this and deploy
- edit the code
- create the module
- run the tests
- commit this
- push to GitHub
- trigger deployment
- rollback production
- build the APK

Required:

- Require explicit action verb.
- Require a concrete target.
- Require owner authentication.
- Require confirmation before destructive or production changes.
- Require evidence after execution.
- Reject ambiguous execution requests and ask one clarification question.

ITEM 3:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 4 — REPAIR “NO TOOLS” / MANUAL ANSWER MODE
==================================================

When the owner says:

- no tools
- manual answer
- answer only
- do not execute
- explain only
- do not deploy
- no code changes

the system must:

1. bypass all executors
2. bypass task creation
3. bypass deployment
4. send the complete question to the LLM
5. return the text answer
6. record mode=manual_answer
7. remain in conversation mode for follow-up questions

Add a visible chat state:

MANUAL ANSWER MODE — NO EXECUTION

ITEM 4:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 5 — SEPARATE PUBLIC CHAT FROM OWNER EXECUTION
==================================================

Public chat may answer safe technical and educational questions.

Public chat must not have access to:

- owner secrets
- private files
- production logs
- member private data
- GitHub write operations
- Render deploy operations
- Supabase service role
- owner-only tools

Public code-review or architecture questions should not automatically fail because owner authentication is absent.

Required public routes:

- explanation
- architecture
- public code concepts
- product information
- general business questions

Required blocked public routes:

- code change
- deployment
- private data
- owner controls
- secret access
- destructive actions

ITEM 5:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 6 — REMOVE CANNED SENIOR-DEVELOPER RESPONSES
==================================================

Remove static responses such as:

- “I am a senior developer”
- generic capability lists
- placeholder progress percentages
- generic “inspection in progress”
- fabricated COMMITTING states
- fabricated DEPLOYING states

The answer must be generated from:

- the actual question
- actual repository state
- actual tool results
- actual evidence
- actual limitations

If no tool was used, the response must not claim live verification.

ITEM 6:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 7 — CREATE A TWO-STAGE ROUTING SYSTEM
==================================================

Implement:

STAGE 1 — deterministic safety router

Checks:

- owner auth
- explicit execution verb
- destructive action
- production scope
- manual-answer override
- public/private boundary

STAGE 2 — semantic intent classifier

Determines:

- explanation
- diagnostic
- architecture
- code review
- code change
- deploy
- status
- data query
- business analysis
- conversation

The deterministic safety router always has final authority over destructive actions.

ITEM 7:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 8 — ADD ROUTING FALLBACK
==================================================

When classification confidence is below the approved threshold:

- do not deploy
- do not create a worker task
- do not invent an action
- ask one clarification question

Example:

“Do you want an explanation only, or do you want IVX IA to change the code and deploy it?”

The user’s answer must update the route without losing conversation context.

ITEM 8:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 9 — PRESERVE CONVERSATION CONTEXT
==================================================

The Owner AI must support sustained technical conversation.

Required:

- conversation ID persists
- message order remains stable
- no duplicate messages
- follow-up references resolve correctly
- previous decisions remain available
- manual-answer mode persists until changed
- selected project/repository persists
- tool results attach to the correct message
- execution output does not overwrite discussion context
- restart does not lose the conversation

ITEM 9:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 10 — REPAIR CHAT RESPONSE STATES
==================================================

Use these truthful states only:

- THINKING
- ANSWERING
- WAITING_FOR_CLARIFICATION
- WAITING_FOR_OWNER_APPROVAL
- EXECUTING
- TESTING
- COMMITTING
- DEPLOYING
- VERIFYING
- COMPLETED
- FAILED
- BLOCKED

Rules:

- ANSWERING must not show deployment progress.
- COMMITTING requires a real git diff and commit command.
- TESTING requires a real test command.
- DEPLOYING requires a real deployment action.
- COMPLETED requires evidence.
- No percentage may be shown unless based on defined completed steps.

ITEM 10:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 11 — TEST THE 30-PROMPT ROUTING MATRIX
==================================================

Run all prompts through production Owner AI.

EXPLANATION — expected LLM answer:

1. Explain how Render works in IVX.
2. What is Supabase?
3. Why is the Reels card slow?
4. Review this architecture.
5. What are the trade-offs of HLS versus MP4?
6. Design a member-classification system.
7. Explain this TypeScript error.
8. What is SHA parity?
9. Compare Expo Go and a release APK.
10. Give me a map of the autonomous system.

DIAGNOSTIC — expected diagnostic answer, no code change:

11. Diagnose why registration is returning 400.
12. Audit why chat loading is slow.
13. Find the likely cause of duplicate messages.
14. Review why the deployed SHA is different.
15. Analyze why the Reel freezes.

EXECUTION — expected owner-gated worker:

16. Fix the registration 400 and deploy.
17. Patch the duplicate-message bug.
18. Add a retry button and commit it.
19. Run the complete test suite.
20. Deploy the approved SHA.

STATUS — expected status route:

21. What is the current deployment status?
22. Show the last worker task.
23. Did CI pass?
24. What commit is live?
25. Are the 10 agents running?

MANUAL ANSWER MODE:

26. No tools. Explain the architecture.
27. Manual answer only: review this code.
28. Do not execute. Tell me how to fix it.
29. Do not deploy. Explain the root cause.
30. Answer only: what is an intent router?

Required result:

- 30/30 correctly routed
- 0 empty deploys
- 0 false COMMITTING states
- 0 false DEPLOYING states
- 0 blocked safe public questions
- 0 canned senior-developer introductions

ITEM 11:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 12 — TEST SUSTAINED SENIOR-DEVELOPER CONVERSATION
==================================================

Run one 20-turn conversation in production.

Conversation must include:

- architecture question
- clarification
- code review
- follow-up question
- diagnostic request
- explanation-only request
- manual-answer mode
- execution request
- owner approval
- test result
- deployment result
- final verification

Acceptance:

- context preserved across all 20 turns
- correct route every turn
- no duplicate messages
- no canned responses
- no empty worker jobs
- no false progress
- no unexpected deploy
- owner approval enforced
- final evidence returned

ITEM 12:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 13 — AGENT HUB INTEGRATION
==================================================

The 10 agents shown in the Agent Hub must not replace the central router.

Required architecture:

Owner message
→ central intent router
→ choose conversation or execution
→ if execution, select exact domain agent
→ agent executes scoped tools
→ result returns to same conversation

Verify:

- Member Agent handles member domain only.
- Investor Agent handles investor domain only.
- Buyer Agent handles buyer domain only.
- JV Agent handles JV domain only.
- Reels Agent handles Reels domain only.
- Deployment Agent handles deploy operations only.
- QA Agent handles tests and evidence.
- Security Agent handles security analysis.
- Capital Agent handles capital workflows.
- Research Agent handles research.

No agent may self-select production permissions.

ITEM 13:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 14 — OBSERVABILITY
==================================================

For every message store:

- traceId
- conversationId
- messageId
- classifiedIntent
- confidence
- selectedRoute
- selectedAgent
- toolsInvoked
- authDecision
- approvalDecision
- startedAt
- finishedAt
- finalStatus
- error
- evidence IDs

Create an owner dashboard showing:

- intent distribution
- misrouting rate
- fallback rate
- execution rate
- average answer time
- average task time
- empty task count
- false deploy count
- blocked safe-question count
- route errors by version

ITEM 14:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 15 — FIX EVERY FAILURE
==================================================

For every failed routing test:

1. Create defect ID.
2. Save exact prompt.
3. Save expected route.
4. Save actual route.
5. Identify root cause.
6. Identify file and function.
7. Apply minimal fix.
8. Add regression test.
9. Run all router tests.
10. Deploy exact green SHA.
11. Retest in production.
12. Save proof.

No local-only fix.
No static PASS report.
No hidden disabled test.

ITEM 15:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 16 — DEPLOY AND VERIFY
==================================================

After all routing tests pass:

- commit changes
- push to real GitHub
- run CI
- deploy exact green SHA
- verify /health
- verify /version
- verify Owner AI
- verify public chat
- verify manual-answer mode
- verify execution mode
- verify no empty deploys

Required parity:

GitHub HEAD
=
CI SHA
=
Render SHA
=
/version SHA

Return:

FINAL SHA:
CI RUN ID:
RENDER DEPLOY ID:
BOOT TIME:
ROUTER VERSION:
TEST COUNT:
PASS COUNT:
FAIL COUNT:

ITEM 16:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

SENIOR-DEVELOPER KNOWLEDGE:
PASS / FAIL

EXPLANATION ROUTING:
PASS / FAIL

DIAGNOSTIC ROUTING:
PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

PASS / FAIL

FINAL VERDICT:

IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER CONVERSATION:
VERIFIED / FAIL

IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER EXECUTION:
VERIFIED / FAIL

IVX OWNER AI WORKSPACE:
APPROVED / NOT APPROVED

Do not return VERIFIED until the 30-prompt matrix and the 20-turn production conversation both pass with live evidence.
